question: First Asian Games were held at ___________.
solution: The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **first Asian Games** were held in **New Delhi, India, in 1951**. It was a landmark event as it marked the beginning of the Asian sporting movement. • The games took place from **4th March to 11th March 1951**, and a total of **11 nations** participated in the event. • The event was inaugurated by the then **President of India, Dr. Rajendra Prasad**, and organized under the guidance of **Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru**, the first Prime Minister of India. • The games included **six sports disciplines**: Athletics, Aquatics (Swimming and Diving), Basketball, Cycling, Football, and Weightlifting. • The mascot for the Asian Games was not introduced until the later editions, but the 1951 games were instrumental in establishing the foundation for **future pan-Asian sporting events.**
